exact.下一块在这个数字下可走。: The next plank exists at this number.
exact.下一块不可走，迈步会坠落回段首。: The next plank is missing. Stepping falls back to the start.
exact.花一块磁铁，不管数字，走上这一格。: Spend a magnet and cross this plank whatever the number is.
exact.改数不够把每格都换成新数字。要选能连着走最远的那个数字。: There are not enough changes to retune every plank. Pick the number that carries you the farthest.
exact.把本局哪一段的数字连不上、磁铁用在第几格写进你自己的 memory。只把这些当作: Write which stage's numbers would not connect, and which plank took the magnet, into your own memory. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.

patterns.zh: 把数字设为 {0}。下一块可走，还能连着走 {1} 格。
patterns.en: Set the number to {0}. The next plank exists, and this number covers {1} planks.

patterns.zh: 把数字设为 {0}。下一块仍然不可走。
patterns.en: Set the number to {0}. The next plank is still missing.

patterns.zh: 磁铁吸住第 {0} 格。磁铁剩余 {1}。

patterns.en: Fell back to the start. Falls {0}.

patterns.zh: 本局走完 {0} 段，坠落 {1}，改了 {2} 次数字。
patterns.en: This run cleared {0} stages, fell {1} times, and changed the number {2} times.

patterns.zh: 磁铁还剩 {0}。磁铁能走过一块对不上的板。
patterns.en: Magnets left {0}. A magnet crosses one plank that does not match.
